per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP rows are linked to this paper and were reconciled against Table 1 and Results text. Most percent-inhibition activity rows are source_verified; the IC50 label and qualitative toxicity rows remain source_conflict with explicit reasons.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary source supports percent HCMV infection-inhibition rows, not MIC/IC50 rows. The empty scaffold was replaced with source-located values and qualitative toxicity evidence; graph-only unreported points were not invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to WWIHS/gB fusion-domain design rationale and entry/infectivity phenotype. No direct fusion mechanism claim is asserted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Abstract says peptides 264-291 and 297-315 individually failed to inhibit; body text reports 70.5% at 5 µM and 40% at 50 µM, respectively. Both source statements are preserved.
DBAASP labels the 174-200 5 µM / 51% inhibition row as IC50 I, but primary text reports percent inhibition, not an IC50 endpoint.
Primary discussion reports no statistically significant toxicity at highest concentrations, but exact cell-viability values are data-not-shown and not per-peptide tabulated.
Figures 3-8 show dose-response plots; local XML/PDF text provides selected exact values only, and no graph-derived extra values were invented.
Peptide entry/fusion mechanism remains inferred from design plus infectivity assay, not direct fusion or structural measurement.
